app.name: Build Zambia
app.tagline: Eight National Development Missions. One Zambia.
guide.name: Jimmy
welcome.hello: Hi! I'm Jimmy. Let's build Zambia together!
setup.title: Make your builder
setup.hello: First, pick a fun nickname. Not your real name!
setup.nicknameHint: Letters, numbers and _ only. No spaces.
setup.missing: Pick a nickname, an age group and a province.
nickname.tooShort: Use at least 3 letters or numbers.
nickname.badChars: Use only letters, numbers and _ (no spaces).
nickname.phone: That looks like a phone number. Pick a fun name instead!
nickname.email: That looks like an email. Pick a fun name instead!
map.hello: Pick a mission! Big numbers are Zambia's goals.
intro.replay: Replay: you earn 25% coins and no new Mission Points.
play.pick: Pick one, then press the button.
done.title: MISSION COMPLETE!
done.levelUp: Level up! You are now a {name}!
done.goalMissed: You grew {n} — the goal is {goal}. Play again to reach it!
done.notPerfect: Great work! Play again to get a perfect score.
profile.title: My builder
profile.nothingYet: Finish a mission to start producing.
profile.deleteConfirm: Delete your builder and all progress on this phone? This can't be undone.
privacy.title: What we keep about you
privacy.body1: We only keep 3 things: your nickname, your age group and your province.
privacy.body2: They stay on this phone. They are not sent anywhere.
privacy.body3: We never ask for your real name, phone number, email, photos or where you live.
privacy.body4: There is no chat. Nobody can message you in this game.
privacy.body5: Build Coins are pretend money. You can't buy them, and they can't be swapped for real money.
privacy.body6: You can delete your game any time from your Profile page.
privacy.owner: Build Zambia is made by Three Hills Zambia Ltd.
virtual.note: Virtual = pretend production in the game. It is not real national production.
error.load: Something went wrong loading the game.
